conceptZh: 太空人玩偶想幫小弟弟搬疊疊樂，使勁過猛飄走，回來後輕輕放，「哥」像疊上去的兩個「可」，哥哥穩穩站高處。
object: a bouncy astronaut toy in a fishbowl helmet, a smaller matching astronaut toy, and stacked indigo toy blocks
morph: two stacked 可 shapes made of indigo blocks, built after a floating overshoot, form the glyph 哥
creativeAngle: 衝過頭：太空人玩偶一用力就飄走、撞上天花板再慢慢飄回；「哥」像兩個「可」上下疊，剛好呼應哥哥幫弟弟疊高高。
promptEn: An 8-second gentle slapstick clip on a clean solid pale baby-blue backdrop. The only text in frame is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 哥, assembled from thick glossy saturated indigo-blue toy blocks, about 70% of frame height, centered with generous margins. Lead: a bouncy astronaut toy in a fishbowl helmet who keeps drifting off the ground at the wrong moment; one supporting toy, a smaller matching astronaut toy with a little antenna. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 哥、哥、哥哥 (ㄍㄜ、ㄍㄜ、ㄍㄜ ㄍㄜ˙); the second syllable of the word takes the neutral tone; slow, clear tones, then silence. Moment 1 (0–1.8s): the small astronaut sits sadly under a tall teetering tower-to-be of blocks; the big astronaut bounds in and, as the first 哥 is spoken, scoops an armful of blocks and heaves them up with far too much power. Moment 2 (1.8–3.6s): the blocks and the astronaut himself shoot upward, he floats up past the top of the frame bumping his helmet on invisible ceiling, arms paddling, while the blocks rain softly into a messy heap; the small astronaut points and giggles with a squeaky wobble. Moment 3 (3.6–5s): the big astronaut drifts slowly back down with a whistle-like descent, lands gently, and on his second, calm try places each block one at a time; as the second 哥 is spoken the stack clicks into the glyph 哥, a wide upper 可 with a horizontal bar over a boxed mouth, and a second 可 stacked below it. Moment 4 (5s): as 哥哥 is spoken, the big astronaut lifts the small one by the hands onto his shoulders so the small astronaut can reach and tap the very top block, both grinning, the small one's antenna wobbling. Final 5–8s: the glyph 哥 holds perfectly still, every stroke complete, while the two astronauts stand beside it, the big one's feet drifting an inch above the floor and bobbing like a balloon, the small one clapping its mitts, with no touching of the blocks. Soft daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other text.
